decisions.reason: The same source message already has a complete MODIFY recording the finalized system layout; the wiring-plan change requires no additional candidate-state update.
The message treats the BOM as already finalized and approved and excludes an additional purchasing list from the milestone; it does not change the existing BOM deliverable or approval state.
Confirming that no additional components are currently needed does not alter the existing off-the-shelf and custom-fabrication strategies.
Finalizing the wiring plan does not change the base-stability or vibration-resistance behavior.
The milestone clarification does not change the selected power source, supply capacity, controllers, or reserve-capacity requirements.
The finalized wiring-plan deliverable does not modify the continuous-operation reliability or electrical-load acceptance criteria.
The source changes the wiring-plan deliverable, not the solenoid mechanism or button-actuation behavior.
The wiring-plan milestone clarification does not change any sealing, leakage, or liquid-containment requirement.
The source does not modify the spout location, orientation, geometry, or fabrication style.
The wiring-plan deliverable change has no necessary effect on bowl removal, clearance, or event swapping.
